subject: general
question: When did the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) issue an advisory to the Centre, the states and UT administrations to ensure widows’ welfare and the protection of their human rights, including the establishment of a 'widows’ cell’ in each district?
solution:
The correct answer is __**June 2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) issued the advisory in **June 2024**.
 
• The advisory was aimed at ensuring the welfare and protection of human rights of widows.
 
• NHRC recommended the establishment of a 'widows' cell' in each district to address the specific needs and challenges faced by widows.
 
• This initiative underscores the commitment to uplift and protect vulnerable sections of the society, particularly widows.
 
• The advisory was directed towards the Centre, the states, and Union Territory (UT) administrations to ensure comprehensive implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)**

 
 
• It is a statutory public body constituted on October 12, 1993, under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.
 
• NHRC is responsible for the protection and promotion of human rights in India.
 
• It has the authority to investigate grievances regarding the violation of human rights.
 
 
 
• **Human Rights**
 
 
• Human rights are the basic rights and freedoms that belong to every person in the world, from birth until death.
 
• These rights are based on shared values like dignity, fairness, equality, respect, and independence.
 
 
 
• **Widows' Welfare**
 
 
• Widows' welfare includes various social, economic, and legal measures to support and protect widows.
 
• It aims to provide them with adequate living conditions, healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
 
 
 
• **District-Level Initiatives**
 
 
• Establishing cells or committees at the district level can ensure that local issues and grievances are promptly addressed.
 
• These initiatives are crucial for effective implementation and monitoring of welfare schemes and advisories.
